scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 workable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptional across assessed content. Scores are holistic judgments of observed mobile-emulated interaction, not win/loss grades or physical-device certification.

reasons.overall_mobile: A complete short mission was achievable with readable objectives, useful navigation assistance and coherent atmosphere. Combat visibility and firing-angle uncertainty required deliberate inspection and repositioning.
reasons.controls: Large fire/move targets, tap aim and hold route/approach substantially eased play. Two-contact strafe plus dash worked visibly. Some taps on covered coils did not acquire; sustained turning and combat flow were not tested continuously.
reasons.gameplay: Observed recovery-to-coils-to-upload progression provided distinct tasks and pressure. Movement to a clear face paid off. Stationary firing was punished, but enemy/obstruction diagnosis was difficult in the crowded coil arena.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive teal/amber industrial station, rain, lighting, signage and clear terminal screens support the atmosphere at this emulated viewport. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Map pauses reliably and visibly closes; route and recovery assistance were practical. Saved/release-use and upload feedback helped. The instructional dialog clipped lower instructions behind its scrolling region and required scanning several control concepts.
reasons.readability: Main objective, health and ammo were legible. Small coil percentages, narrow threat labels and stacked status/service banners reduced world visibility; coil-face distinction took inspection.
